name: Password maker
author: Alfie
description: Makes strong random passwords, easy-to-type passphrases and PINs on your own computer, and says how strong a password is (without sending it anywhere). Nothing is saved or remembered.

tools.name: make_password
tools.description: Make one or more random passwords.

avoid_lookalikes.description: Leave out characters that look alike: 0 O o 1 l I (default true)

tools.name: make_passphrase
tools.description: Make a passphrase of random common English words, e.g. maple-rocket-sunny-otter-42. Easier to type and remember.

add_number.description: Add a number at the end (default true)

tools.name: check_strength
tools.description: Estimate how strong a password is and why. Works offline; the password isn't stored.

prompt: Show generated passwords exactly as returned, in a code span. Don't repeat a password the user asks you to check back to them, and suggest a password manager for storing them.
